comment: N-025 shared GorillaPool endpoint vectors. Replay: serve `routes` from a mock HTTP layer keyed by method + path (path is from the host root: SDK baseUrl is https://ordinals.gorillapool.io/api, inscription content is https://ordinals.gorillapool.io/content/{outpoint}); ANY other request gets `notFound` (the recorded control 404). Then run each entry of `calls` (camelCase names; each tier maps to its own spelling) and require `expect` (deep-equal) or an error whose message contains `expectError` (Zig: any error). `expectRequestJson` is the exact JSON body the SDK must POST. The routes the SDKs used before N-025 (/tx/{txid}/hex, /address/{a}/utxos, /script/{h}/utxos, /inscriptions/address/{a}, /bsv20/balance/{a}/{x}, /bsv20/utxos/{a}/{x}) are absent here exactly as they are absent from the live API.
provenance: Recorded 2026-10-05 from https://ordinals.gorillapool.io with read-only GETs (remediation-logs/N-025/record.py; documented routes per the server OpenAPI document recorded by F-027, remediation-logs/F-027/vectors/d2-openapi.json). recorded=false routes are synthetic tampering cases derived from recorded bodies, and the POST /api/tx response (no live writes were made; its {"rawtx"} request key is schema-documented, not live-verified). Expected values are derived independently by remediation-logs/N-025/gen-vectors.py: getUtxos scripts/satoshis from the raw tx bytes (whose sha256d equals the txid), inscription content checked against origin.data.insc.file.hash (base64 sha256), BSV-20 scripts base64-decoded.

semantics.getRawTransaction: GET /api/tx/{txid}/raw (binary) -> lowercase hex; refuse a body whose reversed sha256d != txid
semantics.getUtxos: GET /api/txos/address/{address}/unspent (Txo[]); for each entry fetch /api/tx/{txid}/raw (verified), output vout must exist, its satoshis must equal the listing, script = its locking script (non-empty). N-159: entries whose `origin` is set (1-sat ordinal inscriptions, BSV-20/BSV-21 token outputs) are dropped before any fetch; they are never funding UTXOs
semantics.getContractUtxo: no documented GorillaPool route looks up UTXOs by script hash: refuse with an error containing "not supported", without a request
semantics.getInscriptionsByAddress: GET /api/txos/address/{address}/unspent; one entry per Txo whose origin is non-null: {txid, vout, origin: origin.outpoint, contentType: origin.data.insc.file.type or "", contentLength: origin.data.insc.file.size or 0, height: height or 0}
semantics.getInscription: GET /api/inscriptions/{outpoint} (Txo). origin null -> error "not an inscription". Fields as getInscriptionsByAddress, plus data = hex of GET /content/{outpoint} whose base64(sha256) must equal origin.data.insc.file.hash ("content hash mismatch" otherwise)
semantics.getBSV20Balance: GET /api/bsv20/{address}/balance (TokenBalanceResponse[]); the entry whose tick equals tick exactly -> all.confirmed; no entry -> "0"
semantics.getBSV21Balance: same listing; the entry whose id equals id -> all.confirmed; no entry -> "0"
semantics.getBSV20Utxos: GET /api/bsv20/{address}/tick/{tick} (BSV20Txo[]) -> {txid, outputIndex: vout, satoshis, script: hex(base64decode(script))}; empty script refused
semantics.broadcast: POST /api/tx with JSON body {"rawtx": hex}; response is a JSON string txid
semantics.anyNon2xx: error (a 404 on a documented route is never mapped to empty/null/"0")

routes.note: recorded with ?limit=2 to bound size; served for the plain route the SDKs call
synthetic: serves tx 8c28... bytes for another txid (must be refused)
synthetic: recorded entry with satoshis 1000 -> 999 (must be refused: value mismatch with the raw tx)
synthetic: content whose sha256 is not origin.data.insc.file.hash (must be refused)
synthetic (no live writes): the documented Broadcast response is a JSON string

synthetic (N-159): a 1-sat BSV-20 inscription output (8c28..._0, origin/data derived from its recorded script) listed before a plain P2PKH output (recorded 8c28..._3); getUtxos must drop the inscription
